items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Yeah, you see, this is Louie, huh?

ctx.x: Yeah, I noticed the resemblance of Sam and his father. Yeah. Here's one picture of the Oliver band over here. Not in there now, let me get it in the back here. Here it is. Look at the door, I don't just light, it burned out a little. It's a little hard to see, I didn't take this cover off. Yeah, I see, I see. Take the cover off, you can see it no easier. They have it in red, they only kept Oliver in the black and white. Yeah, I guess he does, like a little.
Yeah, you see, this is Louie, huh?
Yeah, that's Louie, and then Johnny Dodds and Baby Dodds. That's too bad. Speaking of everything.
